title: Expired approval picks
subtitle: Once a week: the picks on an insurance approval that expired with no sale, per store and pharmacist, so the insurance team can follow them up.

note.pharmacists: Click a pharmacist to see their picks. The pharmacist is who confirmed the pick, else who picked it, else who opened it. The week is filled every Sunday, and the three weeks before it again, so an approval invoiced since leaves the report.
note.picks: An approval picked again after this pick expired and sold at the till is in Sold, not billed when its delivery was never billed.
